A '''giant species of [[Thranta/Legends|thranta]]''' was extinct by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Skeletons belonging to the creatures were found throughout Alderaan, especially in a "thranta graveyard" in the [[Ruur Killik Hivewoods]], where especially high concentration of giant thrantas' ribcages and skulls were found.<ref name="TOR" /> Skulls of the extinct thrantas structurally resembled those of the [[common thranta]],<ref name="skull">{{TORcite|type=other|Decoration: "Adolescent Thranta Skull"}}</ref> though were significantly larger in scale.<ref name="TOR" />
